In this quick run I take on the Queen Kuldra raid in RuneScape: Dragonwilds the fastest way I know: base camp, all ten bridges, then the three-phase boss fight - Anima Cannons in Phase 1, the Pink Barrier in Phase 2, and Kuldra's Heart in Phase 3, finishing with the kill cinematic and the Queenslayer's Reward.
Use the chapters above to jump straight to the bridge or phase you are stuck on. Watch how the route moves between bridges and how each phase is handled, then try it yourself.
